name: IFR2 (RSI2<10 with crypto-Ichimoku + HT trendmode filters)
author: gabrielweich (jesse-strategies)
license: MIT (repo LICENSE; individual authors per README)
indicators: RSI(2); Ichimoku(conv 20, base 30, lagging 120, displacement 60); Hilbert Transform trendmode
entry_long: RSI(2)<10 AND close>span_a AND close>span_b AND HT_trendmode==1
exit: liquidate when close > high[-2] AND close > high[-3] (above highest high of two previous candles)
implementation_notes: HT_TRENDMODE is TA-Lib and is known to be unstable (depends on warmup length) - implement or substitute carefully. Jesse note: README states these are code examples, not profitable strategies.
